_comment: DOUBLER AFTER EXALTED (MTG_DOUBLER_AFTER_EXALTED; USER 2026-11-13: "we need to be able to berserk and Legion
Leadership in the attack phase, if there is exalted ... Anything doubler cast at the end will be assumed to be in
the attack phase"). Turn 3: a ready face-down Blistering Firecat (2/2) and a ready Ignoble Hierarch (exalted),
one untapped Forest, Berserk in hand, the opponent at 6.
DISCRIMINATING: Berserk resolved in main doubles 2 -> 4 and exalted adds 1 afterwards = 5 (opponent at 1, win
turn 4). Cast in the declare-attackers step after exalted resolves (the Forest is still untapped, so the combat
cast is payable), it doubles 2 + 1 = 3 -> 6 = lethal on turn 3. MTG_DOUBLER_AFTER_EXALTED=0 gives turn 4.
